requirements.title: SOC Coulomb Counting Algorithm
requirements.content: The SOC module shall calculate State of Charge using coulomb counting (Ah integration) method by integrating measured current over time.
requirements.rationale: SE_CalculateStateOfCharge() implements coulomb counting with delta SOC calculation based on current and time step

requirements.title: SOC Range Limitation
requirements.content: The SOC module shall limit all SOC percentage values to the range [0.0, 100.0] percent.

requirements.title: SOC Initialization from FRAM
requirements.content: The SOC module shall initialize SOC values from non-volatile memory (FRAM) on system startup.
requirements.rationale: SE_InitializeStateOfCharge() calls FRAM_ReadData(FRAM_BLOCK_ID_SOC) and restores values

requirements.title: SOC Recalibration at Rest
requirements.content: The SOC module shall recalibrate SOC values using voltage-based lookup table when battery system is at rest state.
requirements.rationale: When BMS_GetBatterySystemState() == BMS_AT_REST, SOC_RecalibrateViaLookupTable() is called

requirements.title: SOC String Capacity Calculation
requirements.content: The SOC module shall calculate string capacity as: SOC_STRING_CAPACITY_mAh = BS_NR_OF_PARALLEL_CELLS_PER_CELL_BLOCK * BC_CAPACITY_mAh

requirements.title: SOC Voltage-to-SOC Lookup
requirements.content: The SOC module shall support voltage-to-SOC conversion using linear interpolation on a configurable lookup table.

requirements.title: SOC Charge Throughput Tracking
requirements.content: The SOC module shall track both charge and discharge throughput in Ampere-seconds for each string.
requirements.rationale: chargeThroughput_As and dischargeThroughput_As are updated based on current direction

requirements.title: SOE Energy Counting Algorithm
requirements.content: The SOE module shall calculate State of Energy using energy counting (Wh integration) method by integrating power over time.
requirements.rationale: SE_CalculateStateOfEnergy() implements energy counting with delta SOE = (I*V)/time/3600

requirements.title: SOE Range Limitation
requirements.content: The SOE module shall limit all SOE percentage values to the range [0.0, 100.0] percent.

requirements.title: SOE String Energy Calculation
requirements.content: The SOE module shall calculate string energy as: SOE_STRING_ENERGY_Wh = BC_ENERGY_Wh * BS_NR_OF_CELL_BLOCKS_PER_STRING * BS_NR_OF_PARALLEL_CELLS_PER_CELL_BLOCK
requirements.rationale: SOE_STRING_ENERGY_Wh macro defines total string energy capacity

requirements.title: SOF Trapezoid Current Derating
requirements.content: The SOF module shall calculate recommended operating current limits using trapezoid derating curves based on voltage and temperature.
requirements.rationale: SOF_CalculateCurves() calculates slope/offset for derating curves

requirements.title: SOF Voltage-Based Current Limiting
requirements.content: The SOF module shall derate discharge current when minimum cell voltage falls below cutoff threshold and stop discharge at limit voltage.
requirements.rationale: SOF_CalculateVoltageBasedCurrentLimit() implements voltage-based derating with cutoff/limit thresholds

requirements.title: SOF Temperature-Based Current Limiting
requirements.content: The SOF module shall derate charge/discharge current based on minimum and maximum cell temperatures using configurable thresholds.
requirements.rationale: SOF_CalculateTemperatureBasedCurrentLimit() handles low/high temp derating for charge/discharge

requirements.title: SOF Emergency Shutoff Override
requirements.content: The SOF module shall set all allowed currents to zero when BMS is transitioning to error state.
requirements.rationale: BMS_IsTransitionToErrorStateActive() check sets all pack currents to 0.0f

requirements.title: SOF Configuration Parameters
requirements.content: The SOF module shall use configurable derating thresholds for: low/high temperature charge/discharge cutoff and limit, and upper/lower cell voltage cutoff and limit.
requirements.rationale: SOF_CONFIG_s structure defines all derating parameters

requirements.title: SOF Limp Home Current
requirements.content: The SOF module shall allow a configurable limp home discharge current (20000 mA default) when below low temperature cutoff.

requirements.title: Balancing State Machine
requirements.content: The balancing module shall implement a state machine with states: UNINITIALIZED, INITIALIZATION, INITIALIZED, CHECK_BALANCING, BALANCE, NO_BALANCING, ALLOW_BALANCING, GLOBAL_DISABLE, GLOBAL_ENABLE, ERROR.

requirements.title: Balancing Substates
requirements.content: The balancing module shall implement substates: ENTRY, CHECK_IMBALANCES, COMPUTE_IMBALANCES, ACTIVATE_BALANCING, CHECK_LOWEST_VOLTAGE, CHECK_CURRENT.

requirements.title: Voltage-Based Balancing Strategy
requirements.content: The balancing module shall activate cell balancing when cell voltage exceeds (minimum cell voltage + balancing threshold).

requirements.title: Balancing Voltage Threshold
requirements.content: The balancing module shall use a configurable voltage threshold with default 200mV and range [0, 5000]mV.

requirements.title: Balancing Hysteresis
requirements.content: The balancing module shall apply 200mV hysteresis to prevent oscillation when balancing completes.

requirements.title: Balancing Safety Voltage Limit
requirements.content: The balancing module shall stop balancing if minimum cell voltage drops below 2000mV.

requirements.title: Balancing Safety Temperature Limit
requirements.content: The balancing module shall stop balancing if maximum cell temperature exceeds 70.0 degC (700 ddegC).

requirements.title: Balancing Rest State Requirement
requirements.content: The balancing module shall only perform balancing when battery system is in rest state (current below threshold).
requirements.rationale: BMS_GetBatterySystemState() == BMS_AT_REST check before entering BALANCE state

requirements.title: Balancing Trigger Period
requirements.content: The balancing state machine shall be triggered every 100ms.

requirements.title: Maximum Discharge Temperature MSL
requirements.content: The system shall enter error state and open contactors when cell temperature exceeds 55.0 degC (550 ddegC) during discharge.

requirements.title: Minimum Discharge Temperature MSL
requirements.content: The system shall enter error state and open contactors when cell temperature falls below -20.0 degC (-200 ddegC) during discharge.

requirements.title: Maximum Charge Temperature MSL
requirements.content: The system shall enter error state and open contactors when cell temperature exceeds 45.0 degC (450 ddegC) during charge.

requirements.title: Minimum Charge Temperature MSL
requirements.content: The system shall enter error state and open contactors when cell temperature falls below -20.0 degC (-200 ddegC) during charge.

requirements.title: Maximum Cell Voltage MSL
requirements.content: The system shall enter error state and open contactors when cell voltage exceeds 2800mV.

requirements.title: Minimum Cell Voltage MSL
requirements.content: The system shall enter error state and open contactors when cell voltage falls below 1500mV.

requirements.title: Deep Discharge Detection
requirements.content: The system shall detect deep discharge condition when cell voltage falls below BC_VOLTAGE_DEEP_DISCHARGE_mV (1500mV) and prevent contactor closing until cell replacement.

requirements.title: Maximum Discharge Current MSL
requirements.content: The system shall enter error state when discharge current exceeds 180000mA.

requirements.title: Maximum Charge Current MSL
requirements.content: The system shall enter error state when charge current exceeds 180000mA.

requirements.title: Cell Capacity Configuration
requirements.content: The system shall use a configurable cell capacity parameter (default 3500mAh) for SOC calculations.

requirements.title: Cell Energy Configuration
requirements.content: The system shall use a configurable cell energy parameter (default 10.0Wh) for SOE calculations.

requirements.title: Battery System String Configuration
requirements.content: The system shall support configurable number of parallel strings (default 1, max limited by GEN_REPEAT_MAXIMUM_REPETITIONS).

requirements.title: Module Configuration
requirements.content: The system shall support configurable number of modules per string (default 1).

requirements.title: Cell Blocks per Module Configuration
requirements.content: The system shall support configurable number of cell blocks per module (default 18).

requirements.title: Temperature Sensors per Module
requirements.content: The system shall support configurable number of temperature sensors per module (default 8).

requirements.title: Current Sensor Timeout
requirements.content: The system shall detect current sensor timeout after 200ms without valid measurement.

requirements.title: Maximum String Current
requirements.content: The system shall limit maximum string current to 2400mA.

requirements.title: Rest Current Threshold
requirements.content: The system shall consider battery at rest when absolute current is below 200mA.

requirements.title: Relaxation Period
requirements.content: The system shall wait 600 seconds (60000 * 10ms) after current drops below rest threshold before performing rest-state operations like balancing.

requirements.title: Contactor Break Current Limit
requirements.content: The system shall not open contactors when current exceeds 3500mA to prevent contact welding.

requirements.title: Fuse Trigger Wait Time
requirements.content: The system shall wait up to 3000ms for fuse to trigger before attempting to open contactors when current exceeds break current limit.

requirements.title: Overvoltage Diagnostic Handler
requirements.content: The diagnostic module shall handle cell overvoltage events at MSL, RSL, and MOL levels, setting appropriate flags in database.

requirements.title: Undervoltage Diagnostic Handler
requirements.content: The diagnostic module shall handle cell undervoltage events at MSL, RSL, and MOL levels, setting appropriate flags in database.

requirements.title: Overtemperature Charge Diagnostic
requirements.content: The diagnostic module shall handle overtemperature during charge events at MSL, RSL, and MOL levels.
requirements.rationale: DIAG_ErrorOvertemperatureCharge() handles charge overtemperature at three safety levels

requirements.title: Overtemperature Discharge Diagnostic
requirements.content: The diagnostic module shall handle overtemperature during discharge events at MSL, RSL, and MOL levels.
requirements.rationale: DIAG_ErrorOvertemperatureDischarge() handles discharge overtemperature at three safety levels

requirements.title: Undertemperature Charge Diagnostic
requirements.content: The diagnostic module shall handle undertemperature during charge events at MSL, RSL, and MOL levels.
requirements.rationale: DIAG_ErrorUndertemperatureCharge() handles charge undertemperature at three safety levels

requirements.title: Undertemperature Discharge Diagnostic
requirements.content: The diagnostic module shall handle undertemperature during discharge events at MSL, RSL, and MOL levels.
requirements.rationale: DIAG_ErrorUndertemperatureDischarge() handles discharge undertemperature at three safety levels

requirements.title: Overcurrent Charge Diagnostic
requirements.content: The diagnostic module shall handle charge overcurrent events at cell, string, and pack levels with MSL/RSL/MOL thresholds.
requirements.rationale: DIAG_ErrorOvercurrentCharge() handles 7 diagnostic IDs for charge overcurrent

requirements.title: Overcurrent Discharge Diagnostic
requirements.content: The diagnostic module shall handle discharge overcurrent events at cell, string, and pack levels with MSL/RSL/MOL thresholds.
requirements.rationale: DIAG_ErrorOvercurrentDischarge() handles 7 diagnostic IDs for discharge overcurrent

requirements.title: Current Measurement Error Diagnostic
requirements.content: The diagnostic module shall handle current measurement timeout and invalid measurement errors.

requirements.title: Current on Open String Diagnostic
requirements.content: The diagnostic module shall detect and flag current flow on an open (disconnected) string.

requirements.title: Contactor Feedback Diagnostic
requirements.content: The diagnostic module shall detect string contactor feedback errors for both positive and negative path contactors.

requirements.title: Precharge Contactor Feedback Diagnostic
requirements.content: The diagnostic module shall detect precharge contactor feedback errors.

requirements.title: Deep Discharge Diagnostic with FRAM Storage
requirements.content: The diagnostic module shall store deep discharge flag in FRAM for persistence across power cycles.

requirements.title: BMS State CAN Message
requirements.content: The CAN driver shall transmit BMS state message with ID 0x220, 8 bytes, at 100ms period.

requirements.title: BMS State Details CAN Message
requirements.content: The CAN driver shall transmit BMS state details message with ID 0x221, 8 bytes, at 1000ms period.

requirements.title: Cell Voltages CAN Message
requirements.content: The CAN driver shall transmit cell voltages message with ID 0x250, 8 bytes, at 100ms period.

requirements.title: Cell Temperatures CAN Message
requirements.content: The CAN driver shall transmit cell temperatures message with ID 0x260, 8 bytes, at 200ms period.

requirements.title: Pack Limits CAN Message
requirements.content: The CAN driver shall transmit pack limits message with ID 0x232, 8 bytes, at 100ms period.

requirements.title: Pack Min/Max Values CAN Message
requirements.content: The CAN driver shall transmit pack minimum/maximum values message with ID 0x231, 8 bytes, at 100ms period.

requirements.title: Pack State Estimation CAN Message
requirements.content: The CAN driver shall transmit pack state estimation message with ID 0x235, 8 bytes, at 1000ms period.

requirements.title: String State CAN Message
requirements.content: The CAN driver shall transmit string state message with ID 0x240, 8 bytes, at 100ms period.

requirements.title: String State Estimation CAN Message
requirements.content: The CAN driver shall transmit string state estimation message with ID 0x245, 8 bytes, at 1000ms period.

requirements.title: BMS State Message Content
requirements.content: The BMS state CAN message shall contain: number of connected strings (4 bits), BMS state (4 bits), BMS substate (6 bits), error flags, insulation resistance.
requirements.rationale: Signal definitions with bit positions and lengths for all fields

requirements.title: CAN Standard Identifier Support
requirements.content: The CAN driver shall support 11-bit standard identifiers with maximum ID value 2048.

requirements.title: CAN Endianness Support
requirements.content: The CAN driver shall support both little endian and big endian byte ordering.
requirements.rationale: CAN_ENDIANNESS_e enum with CAN_LITTLE_ENDIAN and CAN_BIG_ENDIAN

requirements.title: Pointer Validation Assertion
requirements.content: All functions receiving pointer parameters shall validate pointers are not NULL using FAS_ASSERT macro.
requirements.rationale: FAS_ASSERT(pointer != NULL_PTR) pattern used consistently across codebase

requirements.title: String Number Validation
requirements.content: All functions receiving string number parameter shall validate it is less than BS_NR_OF_STRINGS.

requirements.title: Event Type Validation
requirements.content: Diagnostic callback functions shall validate event parameter is one of: DIAG_EVENT_OK, DIAG_EVENT_NOT_OK, DIAG_EVENT_RESET.
requirements.rationale: FAS_ASSERT pattern validates event enum values

requirements.title: Three-Tier Safety Limit Structure
requirements.content: The system shall implement three tiers of safety limits: MSL (Maximum Safety Limit - triggers error state), RSL (Recommended Safety Limit - warning level), MOL (Maximum Operating Limit - operational boundary).
requirements.rationale: All limits defined with _MSL, _RSL, _MOL suffix consistently

requirements.title: Temperature Limit Values - Discharge
requirements.content: Discharge temperature limits: MSL_max=55.0C, RSL_max=50.0C, MOL_max=45.0C; MSL_min=-20.0C, RSL_min=-15.0C, MOL_min=-10.0C (all in deci-degrees).

requirements.title: Temperature Limit Values - Charge
requirements.content: Charge temperature limits: MSL_max=45.0C, RSL_max=40.0C, MOL_max=35.0C; MSL_min=-20.0C, RSL_min=-15.0C, MOL_min=-10.0C (all in deci-degrees).

requirements.title: Voltage Limit Values
requirements.content: Cell voltage limits: MSL_max=2800mV, RSL_max=2750mV, MOL_max=2720mV; MSL_min=1500mV, RSL_min=1550mV, MOL_min=1580mV.

requirements.title: Current Limit Values
requirements.content: Cell current limits (charge and discharge): MSL=180000mA, RSL=175000mA, MOL=170000mA.

requirements.title: SOC FRAM Persistence
requirements.content: The system shall persist SOC values (average, minimum, maximum, charge throughput, discharge throughput) to FRAM.

requirements.title: SOE FRAM Persistence
requirements.content: The system shall persist SOE values to FRAM.

requirements.title: State Machine Re-entrancy Protection
requirements.content: State machine trigger functions shall implement re-entrancy protection using triggerEntry counter.

requirements.title: Critical Section Protection
requirements.content: Shared state access shall be protected using OS_EnterTaskCritical() and OS_ExitTaskCritical() calls.
requirements.rationale: Critical section pattern used for state request handling
